description: CR 509.1c an untapped provoked creature must block anyway
note: The requirement alone, with the untap taken out of the picture: bob's Goblin Piker is already untapped, so it could block or not, and bob declines, twice, since the engine rewinds an illegal declaration once (CR 509.1c) and degrades a repeat to the forced one. CR 509.1c's requirement from Goblin Grappler's provoke is the only thing that makes declining illegal.
